div.div:
Why not keyword search?
It returns every page containing the word "assumptions" — far too many, mostly irrelevant.
Semantic search matches the meaning of the query instead.

Send 2 relevant pages to the model, not all 1000 — cheaper and more accurate.

div.div:
The "Brain" is an LLM
It needs exactly two capabilities — NLU and context-aware text generation. Both arrived together with LLMs, and provider APIs removed the cost of hosting one.

div.div: Where LangChain fits: every box above is a component, and every arrow is an interaction that has to be wired up. LangChain orchestrates them — the output of one stage becomes the input of the next, without manual glue code.
